integrity: The global supremum is reduced analytically to two one-variable orientation branches. Exact Sturm root counts certify all possible stationary points after symbolic elimination; a standalone standard-library verifier checks the integer-polynomial certificates and reconstructs the isolated algebraic value. Decimal evaluation is not used as a substitute for the global proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact computation is restricted to the real two-dimensional space \(\ell_3^2\). No general formula for \(\ell_p^2\) or higher-dimensional \(\ell_3\) is asserted. The maximizing algebraic parameter is specified by a degree-seventeen polynomial rather than radicals.
title: Exact T-perpendicular constant of the real ell_3^2 plane
